checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: apiLevel 2.9, all volumes within pipette ranges (p1000 250/400 µL, p300 multi 40–200 µL), wells within capacity, simulator passed and all 16 checks passed.

Check fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact passed with 48 distinct tips; every pick_up_tip is paired with drop_tip; reagents dispensed from above the wells with a single tip per reagent, and fresh tips for each supernatant removal, elution and recovery.

Follows the paper's steps in order: 40 µL beads, 250 µL isopropanol, 250 µL sample, mix 5x, 5 min, magnet 4 min, two 500 µL ethanol washes, 4 min dry, 100 µL elution, 30 s then 90 s, recovery to the 4 °C plate; the 90 µL recovery volume is only a minor choice the paper doesn't specify.
Check 48_samples_to_odd_columns passed; sample_wells fills columns 1,3,5,7,9,11 with one tube per well, and each eluate has its own elution well (distinct_elution_wells passed).

Beads, then isopropanol, then sample; p1000.mix(5,...); a 5 min delay; mag_mod.engage() with a 4 min delay; supernatant removed to waste with the magnet on (checks binding_volumes, mix_5x, incubation, magnet_4min, magnet_engaged passed).
Two 500 µL ethanol washes, each removed to waste with the magnet engaged, then a 4 min delay and mag_mod.disengage() before elution (checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min passed).

100 µL elution added off-magnet with mix(10,80), 30 s delay, engage, 90 s delay, then 90 µL recovered to a distinct well of the plate at 4 °C (checks elution_100ul, elution_off_magnet_then_90s_on, recover_70_100ul passed).

judge.summary: The protocol passed the simulator and all 16 measured checks. It follows the paper's step order, volumes and timings, with a fresh tip per sample and per supernatant removal, and every tip dropped. The only deviation is recovering 90 µL instead of about 80 µL, which I judged minor because the paper gives no recovery volume and the recovery check accepts 70–100 µL.
